subject: mathematics
concept: Simplifying algebraic expressions by combining like terms
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student groups matching virtual mystery-box types together and counts each group
exercise.pictorial: Student circles matching terms in a pictured expression before combining them
exercise.abstract: Student simplifies expressions by combining like terms (e.g. 3n + 2n = 5n)

misconception_flags: combines unlike terms together (e.g. adds a number term to a letter term)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
